chunks: And from him, from Ali, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Ibrahim ibn Abi Ziyad, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about buying from the land of Jizya. He said, then he said, 'Buy it, for you have from the right that which is more than that.'

key_terms.أَرْضِ الْجِزْيَةِ: Land of Jizya (territory where non-Muslims pay poll tax)

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia ruling on buying land from non-Muslims who pay Jizya?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) validates the purchase of land from the *Ahl al-Kitab* who pay *Jizya*, affirming that the buyer acquires a right superior to the price paid. This ruling underscores the economic autonomy of non-Muslim subjects within the Islamic state and highlights the principle that ownership rights are not diminished by the payer's religious status, a key point in Shia jurisprudence regarding *Awaridh al-Amlak* (acquisitions).
